title: # Chat Viewer: every session stored, synced, searchable, exportable as 2-voice audio (Brett, Nov 1 …
asked: # Chat Viewer: every session stored, synced, searchable, exportable as 2-voice audio (Brett, Nov 1 ~3 AM) Read CLAUDE.md, _claude/shared/rules/RULES.md, _claude/persona.md. Opus, one session. Git login works: plain `git push`. Merge origin/main first (other builds are landing). Brett: store ALL our sessions (claude.ai text + voice chats, Claude Code sessions, headless build sessions) as transcripts in a viewer. When it loads, it checks for updates: new sessions, continued ones, changed ones, and updates the stored copies. Export any session as AUDIO with two separate voices: one for Brett, one for Claude (Amber). IMPORTANT reality: claude.ai has no API to pull a user's chats, and we must NOT scrape claude.ai with Brett's login/cookies. Supported inputs: 1. Claude data export: Brett downloads it from claude.ai (Settings > Privacy > Export data) and uploads the zip (or conversations.json) in the viewer (phone file picker). Parse it, upsert by conversation uuid, detect new/changed by updated_at + message count/hash, keep versions. 2. Claude Code sessions: auto-sync the JSONL session files from ~/.claude/projects (root and axfbuild) on the VPS on a timer + on viewer load; incremental (byte offset/mtime). 3. Headless build logs (/root/axf-builds/*/*.log, /home/axfbuild/wt-*/*.log) as 'build sessions'. 4. Hub drop folder: Claude chat sessions can push conversations through axHub memory_write into project amberx-axf, area data, path `sessions/claude-ai/<uuid>.json` (schema below); the viewer ingests that folder too. Document the schema and add a line to _claude/shared/rules/RULES.md: when Brett says 'sync my chats', Claude uses recent_chats/read_conversation and writes each new/updated conversation there. ## Store session@1 schema (framework/schemas + validators): id, source (claude-ai-text|claude-ai-voice|claude-code|headless|hub-drop), title, startedAt, updatedAt, project, messages [{role: user|assistant|tool, text, at, kind (speech|text|tool), toolName?}], hash, version history. Stored on the console data volume (SQLite or JSON files; your call, justify), not in git. Redact secrets (tokens/keys/passwords patterns) on ingest. ## Viewer (console plugin + AmberX entry 'Chats') - List: framework DataGrid (sort/filter/search, date columns), source badges, 'updated' badge for changed sessions, counts. - Full-text search across everything (SQLite FTS or similar), jump to the hit. - Session view: chat bubbles (Brett vs Amber), tool calls collapsible, timestamps, copy/share, export text/markdown. - 'Check for updates' on load + button: shows new/changed/unchanged counts. ## Audio export - Export a session (or a range) as an audio file with TWO voices: Brett's voice and Amber's voice (configurable). Use a TTS that runs on this VPS for free by default (e.g. Piper with two different English voices; install into a container or venv, no GPU), with an optional provider setting (OpenAI/ElevenLabs) if a key is saved in the console keys. Skip tool-call noise; read only spoken/text turns; short pause between turns; chapters per hour. Output mp3/ogg stored on the hub, with a player in the viewer and a download link. Long sessions render in the background with progress. Framework controls + theme/scale tokens only, phone-first. Tests: export-zip parsing + upsert/new/changed detection, Claude Code JSONL incremental sync, hub-drop ingest, redaction, search, audio render (short sample) with two voices. Local test block from .github/workflows/android.yml + theme/controls/lifecycle/menu-reach checks. Phone + desktop screenshots to UI Review via framework/cli/shot.mjs, group 'Chat viewer - Nov 1' (use demo/redacted sessions in screenshots). Add an install_steps part. Commit, fetch+merge origin/main, retest, `git push origin HEAD:main` (never force). Report at _claude/builds/reports/chat-viewer.md incl. how Brett gets his claude.ai export in. Watch live: Brett can watch the screen you are changing hot-render in the console. Whenever you start work on a scre…

result.summary: Chat viewer: session@1 schema + Python port; console plugin chat-viewer (AmberX Chats): SQLite+FTS5 store, claude.ai export import, Claude Code JSONL incremental, build logs, hub drop folder, redaction, versions, search, bubbles, export, two-voice audio (Piper/OpenAI/ElevenLabs) with chapters on the hub; shared rule 'sync my chats'; install steps Part K
